notes.title: 1.2 Version Updated
notes.notes:
It’s Halloween week!
Get some spoooooky feeling with our Halloween theme.
(Only for Halloween week )

Patch Log :
1.2

Update note :
- Weekly Competition is here! Compare your score with other players
- Now you can sort music by alphabet, playtime, score
- Visual effect and haptic feedback enhanced when hitting pads
- Pad size and space customization is available on pause
- Compare your score with your Steam friends' on result page
- Pad design changed
- Minor bug fixed

notes.title: Music Inside ver. 1.1.1 update
notes.notes:
1.1.1
Changes
- Support flac, aiff, wma, asf, asx, wav, ogg file format, now.
- Able to resize hit mode notes.
- Able to load Soundcloud Playlists and play with it.
- Shift key added in virtual keyboard.
- Able to search musics in my computer and My Favorite songs.
- Default musics are changed.
- Able to add bookmark on result popup.
- Cursor appears when using virtual keyboard.
- Difficulty 5 easier than previous version

Bugfixes
- Fix of crash after select music on main scene ui.
- Fixed watertank skin and lightball skin preview looks different from in-game.
- Fixed some note skin size not match to note.
- Fixed virtual keyboard cursor disappear.
- Fixed one letter doesn't disappear when remove all letters on virtual keyboard.
- Fixed wait circle lasts on main scene UI.
- Fixed right hand motion controller invisible in hit mode scene.
